image_urls.title: Image URLs
image_urls.description: List of URLs of the images to edit. A maximum of 5 images are supported.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Text description of the desired image.

quality.title: Quality
quality.description: Quality level of the edited image.

output_format.title: Output Format
output_format.description: The format of the generated image.

enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker
enable_safety_checker.description: Authorized callers may set false to request relaxed screening.

sync_mode.title: Sync Mode
sync_mode.description: If `True`, the media will be returned as a data URI and the output data won't be available in the request history.

aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio
aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the edited image. When set to `auto` (the default), the output preserves the aspect ratio of the first input image.

resolution.title: Resolution
resolution.description: Resolution of the generated image. `1k` for standard resolution, `2k` for high resolution.

revised_prompt.title: Revised Prompt
revised_prompt.description: The enhanced prompt that was used to generate the image.

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.

file_size.title: File Size
file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: The mime type of the file.

images.title: Images
images.description: The URL of the edited image.
